schema_note: SECOND PREDICTOR ARM - Claude's predictions, registered 2026-08-08. SEPARATE FILE BY DESIGN: these must never enter the primary ledger's Brier score or calibration table. The primary run is pre-committed and wraps 28 Nov; contaminating it would destroy the measurement it exists to make. Every entry mirrors a live primary-ledger entry EXACTLY - same claim text, same resolution rule, same ref_date and resolve_date - so the two arms are a PAIRED comparison on identical questions. Only `prob` differs. The `mirrors` field gives the primary entry's id. DISCLOSED ANCHORING RISK: Claude had already seen Matt's probabilities before these were written. To remove the room for anchoring, every probability here is a mechanical function of measured history (see each rationale) rather than a judged number. The method is documented and reproducible; audit it rather than trusting it. Purpose: settle empirically whether Claude's probability estimates are calibrated, instead of arguing about it.

predictions.claim: SUN moves more than 2.0% in absolute terms on its results day 2026-08-12
predictions.resolution: price: abs(SUN.AX price-return) > 2.0% measured from the close on ref_date 2026-08-11 to the close on 2026-08-12. Graded mechanically; no source check.
predictions.rationale: Mechanically derived, NOT judged. Over 8y of daily history, event days are identified as the MAXIMUM-VOLUME day within each of SUN's actual reporting-month windows (never the largest move - selecting on the outcome variable is the bias that left the primary ledger's 2026-08-01 batch over-confident by +0.26). Measured: 11/17 such event days exceeded 2.0% absolute; median absolute event-day move 3.78%. Raw rate shrunk toward 0.5 with 4 pseudo-observations to stop a thin sample producing a confident number. No forward-looking view, no current-news input - the predictor's training data ends May 2026 and it has no market data access.
